(Currently Amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer and a second adhesive layer located on opposite sides of a medial section; and an additional adhesive layer configured to bond with one of the first adhesive layer or the second adhesive layer.

(Original) Claim 282: The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section is formed from a composite material.

(Original) Claim 283: The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section includes a honeycomb structure.

(Original) Claim 284: The tool of claim 281 wherein the medial section is filled with a second material.

(Original) Claim 285: The tool of claim 281 further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers.

(Original) Claim 286: The tool of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

(Original) Claim 287: The tool of claim 286 wherein a plurality of cutting segments are welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

(Original) Claim 288: The tool of claim 281 wherein the tool has a circular shape. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 290: The tool of claim 281 further including a ring wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the ring.

(Currently Amended) Claim 291: The tool of claim 290 wherein the ring includes a central opening. 

(Original) Claim 293: The tool of claim 285 further including a weld ring that is continuous. 

(Original) Claim 294: The tool of claim 291 wherein the ring includes an inner ring forming part of the tool. 

(Original) Claim 295: The tool of claim 290 wherein the weld ring is segmented.
